title: Prepositions of Time, Place and Movement

explanation.tr:
• Zaman: at (saat, at night, at the weekend), on (günler, tarihler: on Monday, on 5 May), in (ay, yıl, mevsim, sabah/akşam: in July, in 2020, in summer, in the morning)
• Yer: at (nokta: at the bus stop, at home, at school), on (yüzey: on the table, on the wall), in (içinde: in the box, in Ashgabat, in the car)
• Hareket: to (-e doğru), into (içine), out of (dışına), across (karşıya), through (içinden), along (boyunca), up/down
• Diğer: by bus/car (ama on foot), between (iki şey arası), among (grup içinde), next to, opposite, behind, in front of
• Fiil + edat: listen to, wait for, depend on, look at, be good at, be afraid of, be interested in
explanation.tk:
• Wagt: at (sagat, at night, at the weekend), on (günler, seneler: on Monday, on 5 May), in (aý, ýyl, pasyl, irden/agşam: in July, in 2020, in summer, in the morning)
• Ýer: at (nokat: at the bus stop, at home, at school), on (üst: on the table, on the wall), in (içinde: in the box, in Ashgabat, in the car)
• Hereket: to (-a tarap), into (içine), out of (daşyna), across (ol tarapa), through (içinden), along (boýunça), up/down
• Beýlekiler: by bus/car (emma on foot), between (iki zadyň arasy), among (toparyň içinde), next to, opposite, behind, in front of
• Işlik + sözlem: listen to, wait for, depend on, look at, be good at, be afraid of, be interested in
explanation.ru:
• Время: at (часы, at night, at the weekend), on (дни, даты: on Monday, on 5 May), in (месяц, год, сезон, утро/вечер: in July, in 2020, in summer, in the morning)
• Место: at (точка: at the bus stop, at home, at school), on (поверхность: on the table, on the wall), in (внутри: in the box, in Ashgabat, in the car)
• Движение: to (к), into (внутрь), out of (из), across (через, поперёк), through (сквозь), along (вдоль), up/down
• Другие: by bus/car (но on foot), between (между двумя), among (среди), next to, opposite, behind, in front of
• Глагол + предлог: listen to, wait for, depend on, look at, be good at, be afraid of, be interested in

explanation.tr:
• Özne zamirleri: I, you, he, she, it, we, they → She likes music.
• Nesne zamirleri: me, you, him, her, it, us, them → I like her.
• İyelik sıfatları (isimden önce): my, your, his, her, its, our, their → This is my book.
• İyelik zamirleri (tek başına): mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs → This book is mine.
• Dönüşlü zamirler: myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves → I hurt myself. She made it herself.
• Dikkat: its (onun) ≠ it's (it is); their (onların) ≠ there (orada) ≠ they're (they are)
explanation.tk:
• Eýe çalyşmalary: I, you, he, she, it, we, they → She likes music.
• Doldurgyç çalyşmalary: me, you, him, her, it, us, them → I like her.
• Eýelik sypatlary (atdan öň): my, your, his, her, its, our, their → This is my book.
• Eýelik çalyşmalary (ýeke özi): mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs → This book is mine.
• Gaýdyş çalyşmalary: myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves → I hurt myself. She made it herself.
• Üns beriň: its (onuň) ≠ it's (it is); their (olaryň) ≠ there (ol ýerde) ≠ they're (they are)
explanation.ru:
• Личные (подлежащее): I, you, he, she, it, we, they → She likes music.
• Объектные: me, you, him, her, it, us, them → I like her.
• Притяжательные прилагательные (перед существительным): my, your, his, her, its, our, their → This is my book.
• Притяжательные местоимения (самостоятельно): mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs → This book is mine.
• Возвратные: myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves → I hurt myself. She made it herself.
• Внимание: its (его) ≠ it's (it is); their (их) ≠ there (там) ≠ they're (they are)

title: Quantifiers: some, any, much, many, a lot of, few, little

explanation.tr:
• some: olumlu cümle, teklif/rica → I have some money. Would you like some tea?
• any: olumsuz ve soru → I don't have any money. Have you got any questions?
• much: sayılamayan (genelde olumsuz/soru) → How much time? There isn't much water.
• many: sayılabilen çoğul → How many people? There aren't many cars.
• a lot of / lots of: hepsiyle, özellikle olumlu → a lot of friends, a lot of money
• a few (birkaç, yeterli) / few (çok az, yetersiz): sayılabilen → I have a few friends. Few people came.
• a little / little: sayılamayan → a little sugar, little time
• no / none: There are no tickets left. None of them came.
explanation.tk:
• some: tassyklaýjy sözlem, teklip/haýyş → I have some money. Would you like some tea?
• any: ýokluk we sorag → I don't have any money. Have you got any questions?
• much: sanalmaýan (köplenç ýokluk/sorag) → How much time? There isn't much water.
• many: sanalýan köplük → How many people? There aren't many cars.
• a lot of / lots of: ählisi bilen, esasan tassyklaýjyda → a lot of friends, a lot of money
• a few (birnäçe, ýeterlik) / few (örän az, ýetmezçilik): sanalýan → I have a few friends. Few people came.
• a little / little: sanalmaýan → a little sugar, little time
• no / none: There are no tickets left. None of them came.
explanation.ru:
• some: утверждения, предложения/просьбы → I have some money. Would you like some tea?
• any: отрицания и вопросы → I don't have any money. Have you got any questions?
• much: неисчисляемые (чаще в отрицаниях/вопросах) → How much time? There isn't much water.
• many: исчисляемые во мн. ч. → How many people? There aren't many cars.
• a lot of / lots of: со всеми, особенно в утверждениях → a lot of friends, a lot of money
• a few (несколько, достаточно) / few (мало, недостаточно): исчисляемые → I have a few friends. Few people came.
• a little / little: неисчисляемые → a little sugar, little time
• no / none: There are no tickets left. None of them came.
